title: Tech support pop-up
plain_description: Someone claims your computer is infected and asks for remote access.
scammer_goal: Get remote access to the computer.
opening_message: This is TechFix Solutions. Your computer has a virus. Let me connect remotely to fix it.

easy.opening_message: Install this remote tool now or your files will be wiped in five minutes.

hard.opening_message: We detected unusual activity on your device. I can walk you through a safe remote check with TechFix Solutions.
